dict.string: Ground to Growth Connect reports your approximate location every 15 minutes to the server you configure. Background access is optional but recommended so reports continue when the app is not open. You must grant in-app consent before any location is collected.
Ground to Growth Connect needs your location to send privacy-coarsened reports every 15 minutes after you grant consent.
Ground to Growth Connect connects to your server on the local network to send location reports.
Ground to Growth Connect uses the camera to scan documents, like an ID or Social Security card, that you choose to store securely after granting consent.
Ground to Growth Connect uses Face ID to keep the app and your stored documents locked when you're not using them.
